candidates.title: Boss Grudge Escalation Audio Sting

This is a zero-asset change: pure Web Audio API synthesis matching the existing soundChainEscalate pattern. Bosses become acoustically alive — Karen recognizing you is now an auditory punch in the gut, not a text swap.

This pattern is already established for escalation (soundChainEscalate) — the decay direction is the natural counterpart, completing the audio arc.

L3.recipe: Full acoustic tension arc: tick (as L2) + break intensity scales with count tier (GODLIKE loss at ≥15 gets a 3-note dramatic descending chord vs soft pop at ≤5). Add 'CLOSE CALL' decay rescue: if player gets a kill within 5 frames of chain reset, fire a 'saved!' rising sting and reset the decay timer.

candidates.title: Run Arc Vignette GPU Dirty-Check (Performance)
candidates.why: drawGame.js:1211 calls ctx.createRadialGradient() every frame for the atmospheric run-arc vignette. Acts change at most a handful of times per run (wave ~10, ~25, ~35), yet a new gradient object is allocated at 60fps. S91 explicitly flagged this as the top technical gap. A gs._runActPrev dirty-check eliminates ~99% of gradient allocations — the canvas fillStyle can be cached as a reference and reused until the act changes.
candidates.recipe: Add `gs._runActPrev = null` to game state init. In drawGame.js:1210, check `if (!_ac || _aa === 0 || gs._runAct === gs._runActPrev) { /* reuse cached */ }`. Cache the gradient as `gs._runActVignetteStyle`. Recreate only when `gs._runAct !== gs._runActPrev`, then update `gs._runActPrev`. Add unit test for dirty-check guard.
candidates.evidence: drawGame.js:1211 confirmed: `ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.28, W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.78)` called unconditionally every frame. S91 SIL top gap note confirms this is a known issue. gs._runActPrev field does not exist in App.jsx startGame state.

L1.recipe: Add `gs._runActPrev` to startGame init. In drawGame.js, skip radialGradient creation when `gs._runAct === gs._runActPrev`. Cache fillStyle as `gs._runActVignetteStyle`. Update prev on act change.

L2.recipe: Full dirty-check + cache: gradient object cached per act key on first creation, reused on subsequent frames. Null-guard on canvas resize (W/H change invalidates cache). Add 1 test asserting no repeated gradient alloc across frames with same act.

L3.recipe: Extend dirty-check pattern to all three per-frame gradient allocations in drawGame.js: run-arc vignette + last-stand radial gradient + time-dilation vignette. Estimated frame savings: ~0.3ms/frame on mid-range mobile.

Extremely high innovation, high effort — a ladder-climb target once lower-effort items are shipped.
